title: Burg
subtitle: Independent
description: Burg got recruited by Ranzar Malk to help bust the Twi'lek criminal Qin from a New Republic prison transport, alongside Qin's twin Xi'an, Q9-0, ex-Imperial Migs Mayfeld, and the Mandalorian. As the muscle of the group, Burg helped make their infiltration a success. Along with the others, he turned on the Mandalorian and, for his trouble, was left in a prison cell.
